payload.content: Python 3.15.0 was released on October 1, 2026. Headline changes: explicit lazy imports via the new `lazy import` syntax (PEP 810); UTF-8 mode is now on by default (PEP 686), so open() without an encoding uses UTF-8; a new profiling package with the Tachyon sampling profiler (PEP 799); plus continued JIT and free-threading improvements. Developers on X are mostly celebrating lazy imports for CLI startup time.
